text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOOO----!!
This is so hypeee--!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, when I came to the trainer's office, Winning Ticket
was making a fuss while looking at her phone.
choice_data_list: What're you looking at?
What are you looking at?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: This is it! Take a look at this!

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
Today, I'll be explaining the shot put!
Just as the name suggests,
it's an event where you throw a heavy metal ball!

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
There are some tricky parts, but let's learn the basics
and safely give it a try!
Now! Please follow my lead—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems to be a race commentary video by
Sonon Elfie, a popular athlete UmaTuber.
It has high view counts, and the comments are buzzing with excitement.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
They're showing us both the fun of sports
and the importance of the fundamentals at the same time!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
The viewers were totally hooked too, talking about how passionate sports can be...
Waaahhh!! It's so amazing~~!!
choice_data_list: Aren't you good at stuff like this too?
Aren't you good at this kind of thing too?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Gasp!? That sounds great!
I wanna share the passion of sports with everyone too!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!! Let's do it, Trainer-san!!
Time for a photo shoot right now--!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Alright everyone, today we're playing handball!
Handball is, you see――

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Working in lockstep with your assist is super important!
You gotta match your breathing, become one, and...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
...Ugh. That sense of unity from
overcoming a barrier together is just, aaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Waaaahhh, waaaaaahhh...!!
choice_data_list: Stop, stop!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Next is high jump! People tend to think high jump is an individual sport,
but that's actually not the case! There are the people supporting the athlete! And—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: "It's precisely because of that intense battle for a single centimeter against rivals leaping ahead and behind that... *hic*... it's so passionate..."

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Waaaahhhhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: We're playing water polo! Water polo is so intense and fiery that it's called 'martial arts in the water,' so... ugh...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOAAAAAAAHHHHNNN!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"They're taking forever to get to the explanation (lol)"...
"What on earth am I watching"...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: No good~~! I want to convey the passion of sports, but look at me~~!!
choice_data_list: Should I help too?
Should I help too?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
!? Yeah! Please!
Having a professional trainer teach me
would be like having the strength of a hundred people!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Now we can deliver the absolute best video to everyone!
Trainer, let's do our best together!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Still, she already understands the joy and passion
of sports. All that's left is to make sure she doesn't
get in her own way with her doubts.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Today is table tennis!
The speedy, split-second clashes
are just overwhelmingly intense... ugh...
choice_data_list: What kind of hot are we talking about?
What kind of hot are we talking about?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Uuum...
Well, let's actually give it a try!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hup! Hah! Yah!!
This sense of speed! This back-and-forth is so thrilling!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, although the view count went up slightly,
there wasn't any dramatic change."

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-saaaaaannn!!!
Did you see the video?!
choice_data_list: Sorry, I couldn't be of any help...
I'm sorry, I wasn't able to be of much help...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
? What are you talking about? My Trainer was
a huge help!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Thanks to that, my viewership went up, you know!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
The video comments were filled with stuff like
"So interesting!" and "Can't wait for the next one!"!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Upon checking, positive feedback had increased, with comments like,
"It's gotten much easier to watch!" and
"I'm always watching on edge wondering if she'll cry (lol)".

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"There are people waiting for me...!
I've just gotta give it my all next time too, Trainer-san!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
View counts aren't everything.
I feel like I was taught something truly important.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Still, she already understands the joy and passion
of sports. All that's left is to make sure she doesn't
get in her own way with her doubts.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Today we're playing soccer! In soccer,
you have to keep running no matter what!
Keep moving until the whistle blows...!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"Stamina was essential above all else for that,
and everyone tried so hard... *hic*..."
choice_data_list: Is it really that tough?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
It's a big deal!
Watch! I'll show you how it's done!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Dribbling towards the goal, closing in... and shoot!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Dodging opponents trying to steal the ball while looking for open teammates... and doing it all while running!
See? It takes a crazy amount of stamina, doesn't it!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
We're playing rugby today!
Fast... powerful, everyone charging forward together
towards victory... It's so brilliant...!
choice_data_list: How are you going to push forward?
How are you going to push forward?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Umm, keep a low posture...
I'll give it a try!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
In this stance, with a whoosh!!
Shoving the opponent aside, charging forward... and scoring a try!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: For this very moment, everyone on the team cooperates to provide the assist!!

I think I'll run a marathon today!
Either way, the only real battle is with yourself!
Persistently, constantly moving your legs forward... *sob*.
choice_data_list: The weather's nice, so why not give it a try?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
That sounds great!
All right, I'll go get ready!

Today's winter sport is curling!
Calculating friction and angles while cooperating with everyone... It's an intellectual sport, you knooow~~.
choice_data_list: Isn't it just like bowling?
Isn't it kind of like bowling?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Not even close~!
Just wait, I'll show you!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Before you slide the stone, you calculate where to throw it! Factoring in where your opponent will throw next—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
